title: Immunity from liability.
bodyText: Anyone participating in good faith in the disclosure or nondisclosure of a government record shall be immune from any liability, civil or criminal, that might otherwise be incurred, imposed or result from such acts or omissions.
bodyHtml:
[§92F-16]  Immunity from liability.  Anyone participating in good faith in the disclosure or nondisclosure of a government record shall be immune from any liability, civil or criminal, that might otherwise be incurred, imposed or result from such acts or omissions. [L 1988, c 262, pt of §1]

 

Case Notes

 

  Cited:  134 H. 181, 339 P.3d 679 (2014).
